answer: An estuarine drone economy mitigates Sybil attacks by requiring each agent to catalyze collected floral nectar into power for an acoustic whisper. Receivers anchored to a harbor jetty verify these acoustic bursts to validate active peers. An attacker incurs the verifiable capital and metabolic costs of deploying dedicated physical harvesters per persona. However, sudden droughts can wither coastal blossoms, cutting off nectar supplies and erroneously rejecting authentic agents.
